Want to watch live sport and original documentaries for free? Check out our website:
Swimming has been a fixed discipline at the Olympic Games since 1896 (men) and since 1912 (women) - and always a crowd-puller! As a classic and powerful sport, it combines endurance, speed and technique at the highest level. Get a sneak peak behind the scenes and watch how Adam Peaty, Kaylee Mckeown, Florent Manaudou, Cate Kampbell and many more train hard to combine their strength and efficiency with perfect technique!
